description: Adaptive Boson Sampling quantum-kernel SVM reproduction (Hoch et al., Nat. Commun. 16, 902, 2025). Experiments are selected by config (see configs/); these flags override single values.

arguments.help: Number of random 80/20 train/test partitions to average over (classification)
SVM soft-margin C for the paper arm (paper: lambda = 50)
Platform simulated by a platform_kernel experiment (A, B1, B2, B3)
Kernel estimator of a platform_kernel experiment: overlap (pure-state squared overlap) or fidelity (Uhlmann fidelity)
